answer_text:
Several affordable CRMs now include email sequences without a separate sales-engagement tool. Good choices:

1. Northwind CRM Essentials - the safe all-rounder: deep reporting and a large integration marketplace.
2. Tallyfox Starter - built for teams under 20, with email sequences on every plan and a setup most people finish in an afternoon.
3. Pipewell Go - pipeline-first and very visual; a good pick if your process is mostly deal stages.

Start with Northwind CRM if you want the quickest setup; shortlist Tallyfox if you expect to need deeper reporting.
